notes: New: Night mode for Omen portals, free for everyone (Cantrip). It dims the whole portal by a chosen amount, keeping the theme's colors, so a screen under your main monitor does not glare while you game.

Control Panel, Portals tab: the selected Omen portal's pane has a Night mode section. "On now", plus "Turn on by itself" options: When gaming (while a game is running), Dusk to dawn (sunset to sunrise at your weather location, or 8 pm to 6…
Touch screens: touch the portal and a moon button appears for a few seconds. Tap it for a brightness slider; dragging it dims the portal right away and saves the setting.
